dedupe_keys.name: ffwc bangladesh flood forecasting and warning decision support system

description: The Flood Forecasting and Warning Centre of the Bangladesh Water Development Board issues the national river flood forecasts and warnings of Bangladesh; its current website is a decision support system implemented by the Regional Integrated Multi-hazard Early Warning System (RIMES) with the FFWC and BWDB's Hydroinformatics and Flood Forecasting Circle. The site read on 2026-09-28 loads inundation and rainfall layers on a Leaflet map, shows flood alerts for the day and links to the old website and to BWDB's hydrological information portal. Coverage is national, for the main river systems, updated daily, in English and Bengali. Access is free viewing; the page offers no download or API and names no licence, so data must be requested or read from bulletins. Caveats: the page renders only with scripts, forecast skill and lead times are not described on the page, and historical archives are on the older site. It supports emergency response and flood hazard exposure analysis for roads, embankments, water supply and power assets in Bangladesh, for example triggering anticipatory action. Related record: data-bwdb-bangladesh-hydrological-data-portal holds the observed water levels and discharges on which the forecasts rest.
